scope: HG-0002 delegated product defaults, document structure and applicable process checks.

checks.label: document_and_json
checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,json,hashlib
before=Path('specs/changes/HG-0002/evidence/before.md').read_text()
after=Path('Product Decisions.md').read_text()
pattern=r'(?m)^### (PD-\d+)\. [^\n]+\n[\s\S]*?(?=^### |^## |\Z)'
old={m.group(1):m.group() for m in re.finditer(pattern,before)}
new={m.group(1):m.group() for m in re.finditer(pattern,after)}
assert list(old)==list(new)==[f'PD-{n:02}' for n in range(1,38)]
marked={i for i,b in old.items() if '**#to-decide:' in b}
resolved={i for i,b in new.items() if '**Delegated decision.' in b}
assert marked==resolved and len(marked)==28
assert '#to-decide' not in after
for i in re.findall(r'PD-\d+',after): assert i in new,i
links=lambda t:re.findall(r'\]\(<([^>]+)>\)',t)
assert links(before)==links(after)
for target in links(after):assert Path(target).is_file(),target
assert len(re.findall(r'(?m)^Source:',after))==37
assert after.endswith('\n') and not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in after.splitlines())
files=[Path('.highgrade/project/documents.json'),Path('.highgrade/project/survey.json'),*Path('specs').rglob('*.json')]
for file in files:json.loads(file.read_text())
coverage=[{'id':i,'prior_question':re.search(r'(?m)^\*\*#to-decide:\*\* (.+)$',old[i]).group(1),'delegated_decision':re.search(r'(?m)^\*\*Delegated decision\.\*\* (.+)$',new[i]).group(1)} for i in old if i in marked]
output=Path('specs/changes/HG-0002/evidence/coverage.json')
assert not output.exists()
output.write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Documentation coverage, not application tests','product_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest(),'entries':coverage},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'preserved_ids':37,'resolved_topics':28,'unresolved_markers':0,'unchanged_historical_source_targets':True,'source_references':37,'json_files_parsed':len(files),'word_count':len(after.split()),'coverage_report':str(output),'product_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
